last_verified.normal_state: Integration head 582b5f6 adds bounded, allocation-free user-space diagnostics for pthread_create failures. The nagi-cli suite now passes (107 unit and 26 integration tests, including four terminal-control regressions); the Windows-safe fixture correction is locally verified. The nagi-posix suite passes (9 tests), package formatting and warning-denied Clippy pass, and the Nagi x86_64 user-target library compiles with five existing visibility/dead-code warnings. Root CI #36233551349 passed Ubuntu and Windows host jobs and target builds through UEFI, but QEMU entered Servo construction, received pthread_create EAGAIN, and timed out without a real pixel checksum or M17 PASS marker. Root CI #36235206493 exposed a Windows-invalid test filename; commit dd192ca fixes the fixture. Run #36235660277 passed both host jobs and advanced to the real M17 QEMU acceptance; its target result is pending. Run #36236310925 for 582b5f6 has both host jobs passed; its target job is pending behind the earlier target run. The app branch audit found no missing source commits to integrate; dirty detached first-party target work remains untouched. M17 remains BLOCKED, M18 remains NOT STARTED, and 0.2 runtime/product stays gated on M30 PASS plus an explicit release checkpoint. Read-only branch comparison at root HEAD a62c63c found no missing source commits on the registered app, SDK, capability-permissions, development foundation, Wayback-ledger, diagnostics, localization, model-runtime, UI, or acceptance branches. The unique codex/parallel-capability-core commit 59d7e10 is deferred because it introduces a competing capability/policy and manifest API across paths owned by other workstreams; the unique codex/parallel-wayback-ledger commit 4943fd8 is deferred because it duplicates the canonical contract and applies reverts without policy/authorization. Dirty M17 and first-party sibling worktrees, plus the Home/Search untracked build artifact, were preserved. Capability Core reports 31 local tests plus workspace check, Clippy, and formatting in a temporary workspace, but the root workspace/doctor and public CI were unavailable. The parallel Wayback branch has no remote or CI run; its reported local checks do not override the missing policy/authorization boundary found in source review.
